reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-FP: resolved sink value is controlled by the startsWith(base) guard. User input 'once' flows through base.resolve(once).normalize(), then the condition 'resolved.startsWith(base)' blocks any path escaping /data. The sink Files.readAllBytes(resolved) only executes when the path is proven to stay within /data. This is a known secure pattern combining normalize() + prefix check.
